sections.description: The big counting numbers, the short fact boxes and the highlight chips on the home page.

fields.help: The animated numbers in "Built big. Built to last.".

fields.label: Number
fields.help: Whole number only, no commas, e.g. 50000.

fields.label: Symbol after the number
fields.help: For example + . Leave empty for none.

fields.help: What the number counts, e.g. "Mattresses a month".

fields.label: Figure
fields.help: For example 30+.

fields.label: Label
fields.help: Short caption.

fields.label: Highlight chips
fields.help: The small tags under the figures, one per line.

fields.help: One card per product area.

fields.label: Card title
fields.help: For example Premium mattresses.

fields.label: Card description
fields.help: Two or three sentences.

fields.label: Tags
fields.help: Short chips at the bottom of the card.

fields.help: Logos shown under the cards. A logo links to the brand website when the brand below has the same logo or name.

fields.help: Used as the logo description for screen readers and to find the brand link.

fields.label: Logo
fields.help: Upload a transparent PNG logo.

sections.label: Brands
sections.description: Every VFI Group brand: tiles on the home and Brands pages, the brand sections, and the footer links.

fields.label: Brands
fields.help: Add, remove or reorder brands. A brand needs a photo to get its own section on the Brands page.

fields.label: Brand name
fields.help: Main name, e.g. Simmons.

fields.label: Name suffix
fields.help: Second part of the name, e.g. Beautyrest. Leave empty if none.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.help: Shown on the brand tile and under the logo.

fields.label: Since line
fields.help: For example "Launched by VFI in 2009". Shown on the tile.

fields.help: Upload a transparent PNG logo. Leave empty to show the brand name as text.

fields.label: Brand website
fields.help: Full address starting with https://. Leave empty if the brand has no website.

fields.label: Brand photo
fields.help: Photo for the Brands page section. Leave empty to skip the section.

fields.label: Photo shape
fields.help: Square suits product shots, wide suits room scenes.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: Two or three sentences about the brand.

fields.label: Collections
fields.help: Product ranges shown as chips, one per line.

fields.label: Title
